# Norns

> Durability for AI agents. An open-source runtime that keeps agent runs alive across crashes, retries, and deploys, without ever touching your API keys or data.

Agents are loops of LLM calls and tool calls that run long enough for the process underneath them to die. Norns writes each step to an append-only log as it happens; workers execute LLM calls and tools in your own infrastructure, and when one dies the next reads the log and continues from the last step, not the first. Retries are keyed so side effects happen once.

Core primitives: Agents (definition of a model, system prompt, tools, and mode), Runs (single execution instances), Event logs (append-only timelines of requests, results, failures, retries), Checkpoints (durable state snapshots used for resume and replay), and Workers (processes that execute LLM or tool tasks).

Licensed MIT. Version v0.7. The reference application, Mimir (a Slack bot), has run on the hosted instance since April 2026.

## Project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nornscode/norns): Elixir orchestrator, CLI, and protocol source
- [README](https://github.com/nornscode/norns#readme): Quickstart, concepts, and primary documentation
- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/nornscode/norns/blob/main/openapi.yaml): HTTP API surface

## SDKs

- [Python SDK](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-sdk-python): Official Python worker and client library
- [Elixir SDK](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-sdk-elixir): Official Elixir worker and client library

## Tooling

- [nornsctl](https://github.com/nornscode/nornsctl): Command-line tool for running a local orchestrator and scaffolding agent projects

## Examples

- [Hello agent](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-hello-agent): Minimal walkthrough agent
- [Mimir](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-mimir-agent): Full example application built on Norns

## Install

Install the CLI via Homebrew, then start a local orchestrator and scaffold an agent project:

```
brew install nornscode/tap/nornsctl
nornsctl dev
nornsctl new my-agent && cd my-agent
uv sync && uv run my-agent-worker
```
